Бакопа.about: Nootropic: improves memory and learning (brain adaptogen).
Бакопа.caution: Bacopa monnieri is an adaptogen from Ayurveda. Meta-analysis 24252493 showed significant improvement in memory after 8-12 weeks. The effects are NOT felt immediately (unlike caffeine). Optimal dose: 300 mg/day standardized extract (50% bacosides). Safe in short-term RCT (4-12 weeks). Side effects: gastrointestinal (nausea, cramps).
Бакопа.food_sources: Not consumed as food (grass in supplements).
Бакопа.guidelines: EFSA: claims not approved; MA—moderate effect on memory.
Бакопа.how_to_choose: Standardization of 50% bacosides; with food (fat soluble).
mechs: Dose dependence: ≥600 mg/d bacosides - working memory up
Working memory: SMD ~2.0, better than ginkgo and low doses (29 RCT, 2107)
Speed of attention and response selection (cholinergic activation)
Trail B −17.9 ms, CRT −10.6 ms; 12 weeks (9 RCT, 518)
Бакопа.myths: “Works like piracetam” - the mechanism is different, slower. “Instant effect” - 8-12 weeks minimum.

Бакопа.title: Bacopa
Бакопа.upper_limit: 300-450 mg extract/day; higher - GI discomfort, fatigue.
Бакопа.who_needs: Age-related memory decline, students in session; healthy adults - working memory.
